title: Government APIs
tagline: Official and community APIs for gov data
description: Truly open, documented public APIs from the Nepal government are extraordinarily rare. This category lists the ones that are real — NRB Forex, IRD CBMS, BIPAD, DHIS2 — plus a few near-public alternatives.

resources.name: BIPAD Portal API
resources.description: National Disaster Information Management System by NDRRMA + Youth Innovation Lab. Django REST browsable API + GeoServer WMS/WFS/WMTS. The strongest official Nepali disaster data API.

resources.name: IRD CBMS / e-Billing API
resources.description: Mandatory real-time e-invoice posting endpoint for VAT-registered businesses with turnover above NPR 25 crore. Tech doc at ird.gov.np/content/9052/cbmsapitechnicaldocumentfor/.
resources.note: [Automated] Link appears to be broken or unreachable.

resources.name: Nepal Rastra Bank
resources.description: Nepal Rastra Bank's daily exchange rates API. The most stable official Nepali government API. REST GET /rates with from/to/page/per_page. No authentication required. Documentation at nrb.org.np/api-docs-v1/.

resources.name: NSO CKAN Action API
resources.description: National Statistics Office data portal — CKAN Action API. Census 2021, NLFS, GDP, National Accounts.
resources.note: [Automated] Link appears to be broken or unreachable.

resources.name: Open Data Nepal API
resources.description: CKAN-based civic open-data portal — relaunched 2025 on CKAN 2.11.3 by Open Knowledge Nepal.
resources.note: [Automated] Link appears to be broken or unreachable.

resources.name: Government Enterprise Architecture (GEA 2.0)
resources.description: Architecture framework for the (still-aspirational) National e-Service Delivery Gateway. Reference document, not an API.
resources.note: Policy doc — gateway not yet deployed.
